rulesPanelEnglish.rulesBoard: 40 numbers. Pick 1 to {max} of them and a risk; ten numbers are drawn, none twice.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesDraw: The ten numbers are fixed by the seed pair and the nonce at the bet, and shown in the order they are drawn.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesPay: The bet pays by how many of your numbers are drawn, from the paytable of the risk and the number of picks. A payout is the stake × the multiplier, rounded down to the smallest unit once.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesReturn: Theoretical RTP is approximately 99% before payout rounding; table precision can differ by up to one millionth.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMaxWin: A stake whose top prize would pay more than the max win is refused before the draw.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesReturnLine: Theoretical RTP is approximately 99% before payout rounding; table precision can differ by up to one millionth.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesFair: The server seed is committed by its hash before you bet and revealed when you rotate the pair, so every draw can be checked afterwards — here or in a public Keno calculator.

rulesReturn.E02 (10 Oct): Every paytable returns 99% to the player (to one millionth), at every risk and every number of picks.
rulesReturn.E08 (19 Oct): Theoretical RTP is approximately 99% before payout rounding; table precision can differ by up to one millionth.

rulesReturnLine.E02 (10 Oct): Every row of this table returns 99% to the player.
rulesReturnLine.E08 (19 Oct): Theoretical RTP is approximately 99% before payout rounding; table precision can differ by up to one millionth.
